description: MainActivity.java defines the MainActivity class for an Android app, which manages UI components, menu options, and logging setup. It initializes a MediaEffectsFragment and handles log display toggling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages UI fragments, menu options, and logging for the media effects app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the MediaEffectsFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, toggling log visibility and updating the menu item title.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically toggling the log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment for on-screen logs.
